package main

import (
	"context"

	"example.com/agentfixture/internal/adapters/inbound/a2a"
	"example.com/agentfixture/internal/adapters/outbound/postgres"
	"example.com/agentfixture/internal/application/usecases"
)

func main() {
	pool, _ := postgres.NewReadOnlyPool(context.Background(), "dsn")
	defer pool.Close()
	_ = a2a.NewAgent(usecases.NewReader(postgres.NewRobots(pool)))
}
